messages.text: Hi, I returned the cordless screwdriver. Please send the refund to my new card, the old one was cancelled.

I found your returned cordless screwdriver. We can’t send its refund to a new card; it must go to the original payment, even if that card was cancelled. The card issuer handles the credit (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Would you like to proceed with the BRL 150.00 refund to the original payment?
